transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because everybody says I’ve been doing too much. But somebody has to get this move handled, rebuild the new garage properly, keep things organized at church, and show the younger fellows at work how the job ought to be done. I just feel like I’m the one with enough drive to get it all done.
Lately, have you felt like you need less sleep than usual to feel rested and full of energy?
I’m not sure what you mean by less sleep. I’ve been busy, but I haven’t really sat down and counted the hours.
Have your thoughts been racing or moving faster than usual lately?
I don’t know. I’ve got a lot on my mind with all these things to handle, but I haven’t noticed my thoughts going any faster than usual.
Is this strong drive to get everything done a noticeable change from how you usually are?

I suppose it is more than I usually take on. Everybody keeps telling me I’m doing too much. But the move needs handling, that garage needs rebuilding right, church needs organizing, and those younger men at work need somebody to show them how it’s done. I feel like I’ve got the drive to keep all of it moving.
In the past, have you ever experienced a period of several weeks where you felt unusually down, depressed, or lost interest in your usual activities?
I can’t really say. I’ve had rough patches like anybody, but I’m not sure I’d call them several weeks of being depressed or losing interest.
In the past, have you ever had other times when you experienced this same kind of high energy and drive?

I mean, people say I’ve been doing too much, but I’ve had times where I just felt I was the one who had to keep things moving. Like now—getting the move done, rebuilding that garage properly, helping organize church, showing the younger fellows at work how to do the job. I’ve got the drive for it.
Has taking on all these tasks caused any significant problems or disruptions in your relationships, at work, or in your daily life?

Yeah. I got pulled from work after a safety incident. And at home, my wife and the family... they stopped trusting me to make decisions about the money, driving, even the move. Things got out of hand.
Is this the first time in your life that you've experienced a period of high energy that caused problems like this?
No, this has been going on about a month now, since we had to start leaving the old house.
Before this past month started, had you ever had an earlier, separate time in your life where your energy got this high?
I’m not sure. I can’t think of another separate time like this before the past month.
